svg.title: Research, requested drafts, and approved existing-draft edits
svg.desc: Telegram messages enter a saved queue. LangGraph answers questions and uses reading tools. Explicit email requests start drafting directly; a confirmation button is used only when the owner asks to wait. Known recipients go directly to writing preparation without prospect discovery or fit scoring. Finding new contacts follows research, qualification and address selection. Both paths retain relationship checks, writing, review and duplicate protection. Existing Gmail drafts are read, revised and reviewed, then updated at the same ID only after explicit owner approval. New website discovery uses keyless public search or optional Brave. The owner sends in Gmail. SQLite or one Supabase PostgreSQL database holds saved state.
